SELECT 
  MAX(ABS(CAST(d.age_count AS integer) - rd.age_count)) as max_age_diff
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN demographics d ON tm.donor_ref_reg = d.contrib_registry
JOIN recipients_demographics rd ON tm.recip_ref_reg = rd.recip_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed';

args.sql:
SELECT 
  MAX(ABS(CAST(SPLIT_PART(d.age_count, ' ', 1) AS integer) - rd.age_count)) as max_age_diff
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN demographics d ON tm.donor_ref_reg = d.contrib_registry
JOIN recipients_demographics rd ON tm.recip_ref_reg = rd.recip_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed';

SELECT 
  tm.match_rec_registry,
  d.contrib_registry as donor_id,
  rd.recip_registry as recip_id,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(d.age_count, ' ', 1) AS integer) as donor_age,
  rd.age_count as recip_age,
  ABS(CAST(SPLIT_PART(d.age_count, ' ', 1) AS integer) - rd.age_count) as age_diff
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN demographics d ON tm.donor_ref_reg = d.contrib_registry
JOIN recipients_demographics rd ON tm.recip_ref_reg = rd.recip_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
ORDER BY age_diff DESC
LIMIT 5;
